blocks.text: [ Principle 03 ]
Principle 3: Introducing My Best Friend
Greeting
Almost everyone in the world has a best friend.
I would like to introduce my best friend 김민수 to you.
About My Friend’s Personal Background
My best friend 민수 is 40 years old and lives in 서울.
He has a really wonderful family that includes a beautiful wife, son, and daughter.
His wife’s name is 박수민, she stays home to take care of their home and family.
His son, 진수 is (14), and he is a student at 한국 Middle School.
민지 is his daughter, and she attends 한국 Elementary School.
His house and mine are somewhat near each other, so we try to meet once a month to catch up on what’s been going on in our lives.
How I Met My Best Friend
We met for the first time ten years ago.
We attended the same school, which was located in a beautiful village.
We were in the same class, so we hung out almost everyday until we graduated high school.
My Best Friend’s Personality, Talents, and Hobbies
My Best Friend is an Outgoing Person
I am very outgoing, so I like to do many things with other people.
He is like me in many ways, such as he is also very outgoing.
Although he is sometimes much more shy than I am.
My Best Friend is Talented
My friend has great talents.
For example, he is very good at English, and he is very intelligent.
When he was younger, he studied all of the time and did really well in school.
He was able to graduate from a very good university, and now, he works for a very prestigious company.
I’ve learned many things about life from him, and I (still) have a lot to learn from him.
민수 always understands my problems, and whenever I need help, he is always there.
I’m proud to call him my best friend.
My Best Friend has Many Hobbies
민수 and I share the same hobbies.
We often meet and do things together.
We both like to fish and play sports.
We try to play soccer together once a month.
We also try to go fishing a few times year together.
Last winter vacation, our families went to 경주 and had a good time together.
Because of 민수, I know how important it is to have a best friend.
